tools.name: design_system
tools.description: Ask Gemini Design Partner for a coherent visual system: color roles, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, RTL/LTR rules and reusable tokens. Use before broad redesigns or when the project lacks a stable design language.

project_summary.description: Product, audience and current visual-language summary.

file_paths.description: Relevant source and token files, relative to the active workspace when possible.

reference_image_paths.description: Optional screenshots or visual references other than the session canvas.

current_behavior.description: Capabilities and semantics the implementation must preserve.

reason.description: Why this consultation needs no canvas, the full canvas, or only a region.

focus.description: What Gemini should inspect in the supplied canvas area.

tools.name: design_screen
tools.description: Design a complete screen or page, including information hierarchy, composition, visual rhythm, states and responsive behavior. Use the full canvas only when whole-screen composition matters.

tools.name: design_component
tools.description: Design one bounded component or UI element and all of its states without changing its behavior. Prefer a cropped canvas region over the full canvas when visual context is needed.

tools.name: design_review
tools.description: Critique an implemented UI against the request and existing design language, rank visual defects and return precise corrections. Supply current screenshots and the relevant source files.

tools.name: design_responsive
tools.description: Resolve responsive, mobile, touch, overflow, density and RTL/LTR layout behavior while preserving the same product capabilities at every viewport.

tools.name: design_polish
tools.description: Perform a focused visual polish pass for hierarchy, spacing, alignment, typography, color, motion and interaction states after the main structure already works.
